notes.text: It only works on your desktop — so take it to the phone.
MCP on iOS and Android — an agent inspects your phone app with every tool.
Simulator or device — a USB iPhone or an Android phone is one port forward away.
Touch input — click taps, drag and scroll move a finger.
Honest refusals — no hover on a touch screen, no window size on a phone.
A click on an element its scroller clips away is now refused, not reported as delivered.
Scrolling sideways over MCP now goes right as documented, not left.
